title: Linear systems: the trace and determinant decide
lede: Particles flow along dx/dt = Ax. You set the trace τ and the determinant Δ of A; the readout names what the origin is.
notice: When Δ < 0 the origin is a saddle: some paths approach it, then veer away.
When Δ > 0, the sign of τ² − 4Δ separates nodes (real eigenvalues) from spirals (complex ones), and the sign of τ says whether paths go in or out. With τ = 0 you get closed loops.
The boundaries are the curve τ² = 4Δ, the line Δ = 0 and the line τ = 0. Try Degenerate node: the repeated eigenvalue gives a single direction that paths hug.
hint: Move τ and Δ, or pick a preset. Pause to inspect the trails.
